text:
Tess (Design Ops): dropped a compact layout variant for the spend cards. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/yyy - focus: token stack ordering and how much we reveal by default. Maya (Product): nice! quick ask from PMs: token stacks should be interpretable at a glance without hover. growth hates hidden data. Sam (PM): exactly. can we show a tiny numeric indicator for each stack slice? think of it like a pill: 4.2k | 1.1k | 200. Leo (Eng): small perf note we render thousands of rows with those pills, paint cost spikes. we can send aggregated counts down and render SVG placeholders. Anya (A11y): please avoid hover-only reveals. keyboard focus, ARIA labels, and readable text alternatives are required. also verify color contrast for the stack colors. Maya (Product): proposal: desktop = pills visible; mobile = pills hidden, tap expands. keyboard focus always reveals content. agrees? Sam (PM): that works. also change label copy from "Estimated monthly spend" -> "Monthly cost estimate" across the console to match invoices language. John (Revenue): when visible, the pill numbers must map cleanly to CSV exports. customers expect CSV columns: token_id, model_name, tokens, cost_usd. Tess (Design Ops): placement question: should the org/project scope toggle live next to timeframe selector or inside each card? attaching mocks for both. Maya (Product): put toggle by timeframe for discoverability; leave per-card override for later if we need it. Leo (Eng): Dev-bot pushed a preview with aggregated pill rendering and keyboard focus. preview: https://preview.redwood/branch/spend-pill-1966 Dev-bot: preview build #478 available at https://ci.redwood/snapshots/478. Anya (A11y): sample aria snippet to include on the pill group: ```html
4.2k
``` Sam (PM): can we also add a micro tooltip linking to invoice detail with exact token counts? keeps card compact but surfaces detail. Leo (Eng): tooltip okay if we lazy-init DOM and reuse aggregated payload. heavy tooltips across many rows is the main perf concern. Anya (A11y): tooltips must be keyboard-openable and have role=\"tooltip\". ensure we don't rely on mouse-only timing. Tess (Design Ops): noted. mock updated: desktop shows 3-digit pills next to sparkline, mobile hides them behind an expand chevron. Maya (Product): decision summary: desktop = pills always visible; mobile = tap to reveal; keyboard focus reveals pills; copy updated to "Monthly cost estimate"; CSV to include token->cost mapping per John. John (Revenue): once CSV schema is drafted, I'll review. example header suggestion: ```n transaction_id,account_id,project_id,token_id,model_name,tokens,cost_usd,date ``` Sam (PM): tiny a11y/copy nit: change CTA "Download invoice" -> "Download invoice (CSV)" when CSV is available. Anya (A11y): contrast check: some pill foregrounds are at 3.6:1 on dark mode. needs 4.5:1 for body small text. recommend bold text or lighter pill background. Leo (Eng): will run a perf pass on a few low-end devices after Tess uploads the mobile flow. Tess (Design Ops): uploading final mocks + mobile condensed flow by EOD. I'll annotate color tokens for contrast. Maya (Product): great. I'll update the spec and leave actionable comments in Figma. will post a short Loom after mocks land. :white_check_mark:
